description:
Perfectly situated in a quiet cul-de-sac moments away from village amenities and Rockliffe Hall, this bright and spacious property is available with no onward chain and is ideal for a variety of occupiers, most notably downsizers. The property offers a sought after location, together with good sized accommodation, private gardens and the benefit of a detached garage. Entered via UPVC front door, the entrance vestibule gives access to the bungalow. There is a separate kitchen to the front with fitted units and good sized living/dining room with windows to the front. An inner hallway from the living room gives access to two double bedrooms and the main bathroom. Outside to the front the bungalow is situated within a cul-de-sac location. The front garden is laid to lawn with shrubbery and the driveway provides ample off street parking and leads to the detached garage. The garage has electronic roller door, light and power. The garden to the rear is enclosed by fencing and is mainly laid to lawn with two shed and a variety of different shrubs.

ENTRANCE VESTIBULE Accessed via UPVC door.

LIVING ROOM Great sized reception room with glazed window to the front.

KITCHEN Separate room with window to the front, fitted units, worktop, tiled splashbacks, sink and space for freestanding appliances.

INNER HALLWAY Access to further accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Good sized double room with window to the rear.

BEDROOM TWO Further double room with window to the rear.

BATHROOM With window to the side, partially tiled and fitted with suite comprising of bath, toilet and sink.

EXTERNALLY Outside to the front the bungalow is situated within a cul-de-sac location. The front garden is laid to lawn with shrubbery and the driveway provides ample off street parking and leads to the detached garage. The garage has electronic roller door, light and power. The garden to the rear is enclosed by fencing and is mainly laid to lawn with two shed and a variety of different shrubs.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band C Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
